name: Day-Ahead Electricity Prices
description: Hourly electricity prices from Energy Charts API (Fraunhofer ISE) - No registration required!
author: WattsOn

changelog.author: WattsOn
changes: Price data used by SmartEco strategy for negative price detection and curtailment logic
grid:pricing capability consumed by strategy engine for 96-slot day plan generation

changelog.author: WattsOn
changes: Added negative price handling: signals CURTAIL_SOLAR when price <= 0 and battery full
Prices now exposed via grid:pricing capability for cross-module consumption
Daily fetch scheduled at 14:00 after ENTSO-E publication window

changelog.author: WattsOn
changes: Initial release — day-ahead prices from Fraunhofer ISE Energy Charts API
No API token or registration required
Hourly prices stored in day_ahead_prices table
Collector runs every hour, full daily fetch at 14:00
